FARMYARD BY THE RED BARN: a plump red barn with white-trim shutters and a golden weathervane, a flower-draped picket fence, stacked hay bales tied with twine, a wooden cart heaped with pumpkins, a birdhouse on a painted post, and a round water trough with a ladle hung on the side

FARMYARD BESIDE THE SILO: a tall striped silo beside a red barn door propped open with a barrel, a wheelbarrow tipped full of turnips, a flower box on every windowsill, a rope-and-bucket well, and a cobblestone path edged with cheerful yellow marigolds

FARMYARD NEAR THE HAYSTACKS: three towering haystacks behind a cheerful red barn, a pitchfork leaning against a fence post wrapped in climbing roses, a line of clay pots, a little lantern on a hook, and a wooden crate stamped with a carrot symbol stacked by the gate

ORCHARD OF ROSY APPLE TREES: rows of round-crowned apple trees with low-hanging fruit, a wicker basket on a wooden ladder rung, a barrel beneath the widest trunk, a birdhouse hung from a branch, and a mossy stone wall edging the path between the trees

PEAR ORCHARD WITH A GATE: a white gate between two pear trees, a cobblestone lane between fruiting rows, a harvest crate on wheels, a little lantern post draped in ivy, a bird feeder shaped like a tiny barn, and a flower box of lavender at the path's entrance

CHERRY ORCHARD CORNER: a cluster of cherry trees with branches nearly touching, a tall wooden ladder leaning against a trunk, a row of lidded jars on a low shelf nailed between two posts, a cheerful flag on a bamboo cane, and a wheelbarrow loaded with berry baskets

POND EDGE WITH A TINY DOCK: a small round pond rimmed with cattails and lily pads, a three-plank dock with a lantern post, a rowboat the size of a bathtub tied to a ring, a willow leaning over the water, and a little crab-trap basket dangling from a rope

POND EDGE WITH A FISHING STOOL: a glassy pond ringed with reeds and rounded stones, a wooden fishing stool on a plank dock, a tackle box painted with a fish symbol, two lanterns on low posts, and flower bushes tumbling over the bank between tufts of tall grass

POND EDGE BY THE BRIDGE: a mossy plank bridge arching over a narrow inlet, lily pads dotting the water below, a dock with a coiled rope, a basket of river stones, a birdhouse on a leaning post, and a path of round stepping stones leading to a flower-edged bench

BAKERY FRONT WITH FLOWER BOXES: a round-topped bakery door painted butter-yellow, overflowing flower boxes under each window, a chalkboard sign carrying only a loaf-of-bread drawing, a striped awning, two baskets of buns on a stoop, and a lantern on a curling iron bracket

CAFÉ FRONT WITH A GARDEN PATH: a cobblestone path to a sage-green café door, a picket fence woven with roses, a small round table with two stools, a menu board marked with a steaming-mug symbol, hanging baskets of trailing flowers, and a barrel planter on each side of the step

BAKERY CORNER WITH A CART: a half-timbered bakery wall with a Dutch door, a wooden cart with a striped canopy carrying tiered trays, a barrel of rolling pins by the step, flower boxes at every sill, a lantern on a post, and a path of clay tiles leading to the entrance

MARKET SQUARE WITH STALLS: four wooden market stalls with striped canopies, crates of root vegetables stacked in cheerful pyramids, barrels with pictorial vegetable labels, hanging lanterns strung between posts, a cobblestone square, and a central barrel planter crowned with sunflowers

MARKET SQUARE BY THE WELL: a round stone well at the centre of a cobbled square, surrounding stalls draped in bunting, baskets of herbs on low benches, a signpost with pictorial arrows, a flower cart, and lanterns on tall iron posts ringing the whole cheerful plaza

GREENHOUSE WITH POTTING BENCHES: an arched glass greenhouse with a red-painted frame, potting benches lined with terracotta pots, hanging planters of trailing green, a wheelbarrow of fresh soil, seed packets fanned in a crate, and a trellis of climbing vines just inside the open door

GREENHOUSE ON THE HILL: a small octagonal greenhouse with a copper-coloured dome, flower boxes around the base, a path of round stones leading to the entrance, a barrel of long-handled tools outside, a birdhouse on the corner post, and a watering can on the step

FARMHOUSE PORCH WITH A SWING: a wide farmhouse porch with a hanging swing, a row of potted herbs along the railing, a welcome mat with a sunflower motif, a lantern on each post, a barrel of garden tools by the door, and a flower box bursting at every window

FARMHOUSE PORCH WITH ROCKERS: a deep shaded porch with two wooden rocking chairs, a side table bearing a jar of wildflowers, flower-covered lattice panels, a row of labelled seed jars on the railing shelf, a birdhouse overhead, and a garden path of oval stones leading to the step

FARMHOUSE PORCH AND GARDEN: a farmhouse front porch wrapped in climbing roses, a picket-fence gate at the end of a pebble path, flower beds edged with whitewashed stones, a basket trug by the door, a birdhouse on a post by the fence, and a watering can leaning on the step

STRAWBERRY PATCH BY THE FENCE: neat rows of leafy strawberry plants bordered by a white picket fence, a flat wicker basket on a low stool, a wooden sign carrying a strawberry symbol, a barrel planter at the corner, and a cheerful bunting of triangular flags strung along the fence rail

PUMPKIN PATCH WITH A WAGON: fat orange pumpkins of every size covering a tidy patch, a wooden wagon heaped with the roundest ones, a hay bale used as a seat, a lantern on a tall stake, a scarecrow post hung with a ribbon, and a wicker arch at the entrance

FLOWER FIELD WITH A WINDMILL: a windmill with a spinning four-blade wheel rising above a sea of mixed blooms in pink and yellow, a winding dirt path through the rows, a low wooden fence along the edge, hanging baskets on the windmill post, and a little gate of twisted branches at the entrance

FLOWER FIELD ALONG THE LANE: long rows of lavender and sunflowers beside a stone-edged lane, a wooden arch wrapped in blooms at the field entrance, a flat cart for carrying bouquets, a birdhouse on a painted post, flower baskets hung from a rail, and a round stepping-stone path through the middle

VILLAGE LANE WITH LANTERN POSTS: a curving cobblestone lane lined with iron lantern posts, cottage walls covered in climbing roses, flower boxes at every window, a low stone wall edging the path, a wooden bench beside a barrel planter, and a birdhouse mounted on the corner of a picket fence

VILLAGE LANE BY THE LITTLE BRIDGE: a stone-arched bridge over a narrow stream on a winding village lane, flower baskets hanging from the bridge rail, cottage walls draped in ivy, cobblestones edged with mossy planters, a signpost marked with a house symbol, and a row of lanterns leading the eye around the bend
